lines.text: The high priest Ananias and some elders brought a lawyer named Tertullus, who called Paul a ringleader of the Nazarenes.
Tertullus opened by telling Felix that his foresight had brought improvements to the nation and lasting peace.
Paul told Felix that he had gone up to Jerusalem to worship no more than seven days earlier.
Felix adjourned the hearing until Lysias the commander came, and he ordered Paul kept under guard with some freedom.
Felix hoped for a bribe from Paul, and after two years he was succeeded by Pontius Pilate.
